<!--
合并只看代码质量，规则见 CONTRIBUTING.md。
We merge on code quality alone; see CONTRIBUTING.md.
-->

## 为什么 / Why

<!-- 解决什么问题；有 issue 就写 Closes #N / The problem this solves; link the issue with Closes #N -->

## 改了什么 / What changed

<!-- 一两句话 / One or two sentences -->

## 怎么验证的 / How it was verified

<!-- 跑了哪些命令、在哪个版本哪个加载器里真机试了什么 / Commands run, and what you tried in game on which version and loader -->

## 自查 / Checklist

- [ ] 这个 PR 只做一件事 / This PR does one thing
- [ ] 我能解释每一处改动为什么这样写 / I can explain why every change is written the way it is
- [ ] 修的是根因，没有加兜底或绕过 / It fixes the root cause, with no fallback or workaround added
- [ ] 没有顺手重构、改格式或改无关文件 / No drive-by refactors, reformatting or unrelated files
- [ ] 同一个判断没有在第二个地方再写一份 / No logic that already exists elsewhere was written again
- [ ] 单测与 GameTest 通过 / Unit tests and GameTests pass
